title: Rate Limiting That Actually Works
description: Stop outages and protect your APIs. Learn the critical differences between token bucket and sliding window algorithms, and how to build a distributed…
linkedinHook: Your production systems are running without the right rate limiter, and it's a ticking time bomb. Here's how to build one that genuinely protects.
linkedinBody: I just wrote about designing rate limiters that actually work, especially in distributed environments. It covers critical algorithm choices, implementing with Redis Lua for atomic operations, and where to place limits in your architecture.
